property_summary: The reference contract always returns the semantic version string "1.0.0" from version(); the mutant returns a different string for some inputs (e.g., when called by any caller), so asserting version() equals "1.0.0" holds for the reference for all callers but fails for the mutant.
change_summary: Change returned semantic version string from "1.0.0" to "1.1.0" (minor bump).
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.1.0"; }
